title: Project Galileo briefing and its two directives

tellings.quote: Galileo dealt with the propulsion system of the craft and

plain: Around 1988 and 1989, Bob Lazar says, he was given a briefing on Project Galileo at S-4, a secret site in Nevada where he says he worked on craft not built by humans, and that "Galileo dealt with the propulsion system of the craft." Lazar tells Michels this himself and also mentions a second briefing, on a Project Looking Glass. If true, it would mean the government ran named projects to study how such craft move.
